title: Sapiens2: Meta's Foundation Models for Human-Centric Vision
summary: Sapiens2 is a suite of foundation models from Meta AI designed for precise human body reconstruction and analysis from single images. It supports 2D pose estimation, body-part segmentation, surface normals, and 3D geometry recovery at up to 4K resolution.
research_notes: The model tracks 308 keypoints and is released under the Sapiens2 License with weights available on Hugging Face.

evolution.summary: Sapiens2 scales the original 2024 project to 1 billion training images and 5 billion parameters. It introduces pointmap and albedo estimation alongside significantly improved performance in pose and segmentation tasks.
